# CPC title list excerpt (test data)

These are lines copied unchanged from the official **CPC Title List 2026.08**
(`CPCTitleList202608.zip`, sha256
`cd3a64318110395804de7df411e8036211fc3379d93b1a7deb77975777541f92`) from
https://www.cooperativepatentclassification.org/sites/default/files/cpc/bulk/CPCTitleList202608.zip.

The excerpt contains:
- every entry under G06F40, G06N3 and G10L15/18;
- the codes of the US Google Patents fixture pages;
- all ancestors of those entries.

Lines are kept in the file's original order, so parent groups compute exactly as they do
for the full list. The tests zip these files into a title-list archive.
